category.title: AEO Tools, Build Stacks & Agencies
category.subtitle: How to choose your answer-engine strategy: Buy, Build, or Hire. The players, how to read them, kept current.

method.scores: Presence / Velocity / Agent-Readiness, set by the AdamGTM Analyst Desk, refreshed weekly, relative across the tracked set. Each carries a short reason.
method.ai_visibility: Weekly run of buyer-intent queries across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude; counts are how often each vendor is named in web-grounded answers. Latest run: 2026-06-14.

entities.name: Adobe LLM Optimizer
entities.summary: Adobe's enterprise AEO/GEO application, generally available since October 14, 2025, inside Adobe Experience Cloud with native Adobe Experience Manager integration. It measures brand visibility in AI answers, benchmarks share of voice against competitors, and recommends and implements fixes.

presence.why: New (GA Oct 2025) but Adobe Experience Cloud distribution

velocity.why: Fresh GA, Adobe shipping machine behind it

agent_readiness.why: Adobe APIs; agent surface still maturing

entities.name: Open Source AEO Projects & Resources
entities.summary: The open-source side of AEO/GEO is moving fast. This is the curated landscape — skill packs, frameworks, trackers, publisher-side tooling, and the academic work — for teams that want to build rather than buy. Star counts are a rough proxy for traction, not quality; pick on fit and license.

entities.name: Ahrefs
entities.summary: Singapore-based, bootstrapped SEO platform (~196 employees) extending from its crawler infrastructure into AEO/GEO. Recent releases: the Brand Radar AI-visibility index plus Custom Prompt Tracking, the free Firehose web-mentions API, official MCP across five AI clients, and Agent A, a standalone $99/month AI marketing agent.

presence.why: ~$149M rev, bootstrapped, dominant SEO; AEO bolt-on

velocity.why: Steady; AEO is strong add-on not core focus

agent_readiness.why: Official MCP plus mature API

entities.name: AirOps
entities.summary: AI content-operations platform for marketing teams in the AEO/GEO category. Customers include Carta, Webflow, Klaviyo, and Ramp. $62.5M raised at a $225M valuation. Recent releases: the Quill AI-search agent, Prompt Discovery, and the Page360 content-performance layer.

presence.why: $62M raised, $225M val, Ramp/Wiz/Klaviyo logos; native AEO

velocity.why: Headcount 20→100 in a year; fresh Series B

agent_readiness.why: Official MCP + Claude Connector, REST API, Client SDK

entities.summary: Decision-stage AI-answer measurement platform that scores whether a brand survives to the final purchase recommendation, not just whether it shows up. Coined the category "Agentic Brand Control" and the metric Conversational Survival Rate. Runs multi-turn buying-sequence probes across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok. Founder commentary featured in Fortune (Jan 2026). Funding and cust

velocity.why: Active publish/ship cadence — AIVO Optimize, AIVO Edge, and the Agentic Brand Control category paper all May 2026

agent_readiness.why: No API/MCP/SDK/CLI product surface; only a public spec repo for the AIVO Standard

entities.name: Amplitude
entities.summary: Public product-analytics platform (NASDAQ: AMPL) extending into AI visibility. The classic Amplitude Analytics, Experiment, and Session Replay suite now sits alongside AI Visibility, a visibility score across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. entities.name: Amsive
entities.summary: Full-service performance marketing agency and home of Lily Ray, VP of SEO & AI Search and one of the most recognized figures in SEO and AEO. In June 2025 Amsive formally expanded its search practice with an Answer Engine Optimization offering aimed at brands navigating AI search, leaning on a search team of more than 35 specialists.

entities.name: Animalz
entities.summary: Content marketing agency for enterprise SaaS, known for expert-interview-driven editorial, now running an AEO program. Engagements start with an AEO audit that benchmarks a brand's AI visibility against competitors and produces a 90-day execution roadmap.

entities.name: AthenaHQ
entities.summary: AthenaHQ is an AEO/GEO optimization platform for AI-search visibility, used by Coupons.com, Checkr, and Rootly, with about $3M raised. Recent work includes the Athena Citation Engine validation, Oracle for correcting AI claims about a brand, and an OAuth-scoped MCP server.

entities.name: Bluefish AI
entities.summary: Enterprise AEO/GEO platform for Fortune 500 brands, focused on AI visibility, influence, and brand verification across ChatGPT, Google AI, Claude, and Perplexity. Customers include Adidas, LVMH, and American Express. $68M raised. Recent releases: AI Accuracy verification, the State of Enterprise Brands benchmark, and Collections.

entities.name: Botify
entities.summary: Enterprise SEO platform from Paris, now an AEO/GEO platform built on first-party crawl and log-file data, with 500+ customers and ~$85M raised. Recent releases include AI Visibility, Agentic Feeds, and Product Cards that track brand presence in AI shopping carousels.

Customers include Kimberly-Clark, Estée Lauder, LG, and The Hartford. $30M Series A led by Pelion in Feb 2026 (~$35.75M total). Recent direction: expanding from AI search visibility into AI ads and agentic commerce.

entities.name: BrightEdge
entities.summary: Enterprise SEO platform retrofitting for the answer-engine era, now tracking brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. presence.why: ~$120M ARR, 57% of F500; corpus SOV gap

entities.name: Clay
entities.summary: AI-native GTM data platform for enrichment, scoring, and agentic outbound, used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, and HubSpot. $202M raised at a $5B valuation. Recent releases: Audiences with unlimited searches, distribution inside OpenAI Codex, and Clay Functions callable from Claude and ChatGPT.

presence.why: $5B val, $100M+ ARR, 14k customers — ubiquitous GTM product

presence.why: $210M, 16yr enterprise platform, Forrester Leader

agent_readiness.why: AgentStack AEO new; enterprise integrations but thin agent surface

entities.summary: daydream is an AI-native SEO and AEO/GEO firm built as an agency-as-product: SEO agents execute while a dedicated human Growth Lead owns strategy. Customers include Twingate, Clay, and Beautiful.ai. $21M raised. Recent: the Sunbeam autonomous agent, a $15M Series A, and a Shorty Awards GEO honor.

velocity.why: Ships steadily for a small bootstrapped team

Clients include Webflow and Fourthwall. Recent work: a June 2026 model-collapse study, "AI Is Much Bigger Than You Think," and a search-isn't-dying analysis.

entities.summary: iPullRank is Mike King's New York technical-SEO agency, now built around AI search and his Relevance Engineering framework. Recent work: the AI Search Strategic Roadmap service, click-to-citation measurement metrics, and the open-source Qforia query-fan-out tool.

The classic PR, social-listening, and influencer suite now sits alongside GenAI Lens, an AI-visibility tracker across 7 platforms, and Mira, the AI assistant layer. Recent moves: GenAI Lens launch,

entities.name: Noble
entities.summary: The earned-media and source-acquisition layer for AEO. Noble finds the prompts where a brand is absent from AI answers, contacts the third-party publishers the LLMs actually cite, and negotiates placements it calls "Mention Offers." It's the activation arm that monitoring tools plug into — a different slot in the stack than a tracker. Company details (founder, funding, headcount) are undisclosed.

entities.name: Notebook Agency
entities.summary: Founder-led boutique SEO/GEO shop for B2B SaaS, founded 2019 and run by Steve Toth, creator of the SEO Notebook and AI Notebook newsletters (27K+ combined subscribers). Frames the shift bluntly — "AEO is eating SEO" — and brings that point of view to a small, senior team rather than a monitoring tool.

entities.name: Obility
entities.summary: B2B digital marketing agency for hyper-growth tech and SaaS companies, founded in 2011 by Mike Nierengarten and based in Portland, OR. Obility positions on pipeline and revenue rather than traffic, and runs a branded Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) service framed as complementary to SEO rather than a replacement.

entities.name: OtterlyAI
entities.summary: Bootstrapped AI-search monitoring platform positioned as "Semrush for AI search," tracking brand visibility across six AI engines, with customers including Videoloft and Bacula Enterprise. Recent releases: a Public API, a packaged Claude Skill, and a Marketplace of 101 marketing workflows.

presence.why: Bootstrapped category floor ($29/mo), Gartner Cool Vendor

entities.summary: An AEO/GEO platform for AI search analytics, brand tracking, and competitor benchmarking, built for mid-market teams and agencies. velocity.why: Fast specialist shipping; capable MCP recently added

agent_readiness.why: Capable MCP server plus monitoring API

entities.name: Profound
entities.summary: Full-suite AEO/GEO platform, enterprise-focused. Customers include Snap, Coinbase, Figma, and Expedia. $155M raised at a roughly $1B valuation. Recent releases: Agent Analytics benchmarking, OpenAI Ads nodes, and a 2026 roadmap of always-on Background Agents.

entities.summary: Quattr is an AI-native search visibility platform that unifies SEO, AEO, and GEO into one workflow for mid-market and enterprise brands.
